dialogues.jp:
せっかく人が飯を食いに来てやったというのに
いないとはどういうことだ。
dialogues.en: I'd finally arrived at the rooftop to have lunch, but...
dialogues.text: I'd finally arrived at the rooftop to have lunch, but...

dialogues.jp:
水越姉妹の姿はそこにはなく、いつものテーブ
ルも綺麗に片づけられたままだった。
dialogues.en:
Even though the familiar prettily-dressed table was there,
the Mizukoshi sisters were nowhere to be found.
dialogues.text:
Even though the familiar prettily-dressed table was there,
the Mizukoshi sisters were nowhere to be found.

dialogues.jp:
漏らすように呟くと、腹の虫がまるで同意する
かのように情けなく鳴った。
dialogues.en: My stomach echoed a similar question by rumbling.
dialogues.text: My stomach echoed a similar question by rumbling.

dialogues.jp:
せっかく水越姉妹の鍋を食べに来たというのに、
今日に限って、屋上はがらんどうだった。
dialogues.en:
I'd finally decided to go to the rooftop to eat with the
Mizukoshi sisters, but they weren't around.
dialogues.text:
I'd finally decided to go to the rooftop to eat with the
Mizukoshi sisters, but they weren't around.

dialogues.jp: まったく、人の気も知らないで！
dialogues.en: Geez, tell others if you're not going to be there!
dialogues.text: Geez, tell others if you're not going to be there!

dialogues.jp: 俺のおなかが情けなく、ぐ〜と鳴った。
dialogues.en: My stomach continued grumbling in hunger.
dialogues.text: My stomach continued grumbling in hunger.
